- Ablation (GPT-5.2 + Codex, LLM file without testing / overview / tooling, categories removed with GPT-5.4, Table 7): CTX accuracy 66.67 / 62.32 / 63.77% vs full 68.12%; SWE 57.72 / 54.20 / 53.69% vs 54.36%; none significant; cost CTX $0.3730 / $0.4027 / $0.4815 vs $0.4715, SWE $0.2756 / $0.3018 / $0.2715 vs $0.3272; removing testing lowers cost significantly on both benchmarks (p = 0.023 CTX, 0.0035 SWE), removing tooling on SWE-bench (p = 0.0012)

Verdicts: quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors (all configurations)
